tools.name: search_dashboards
tools.title: Search dashboards
tools.description: Find Reporting Insights dashboards whose content matches a query. Searches names, descriptions, tags, chart titles, database + column names, SQL text, and parameters. Returns ranked matches (id, name, description, databases, sheet/chart summary) — use this to answer "which dashboard shows X?".

query.title: Search query
query.description: What to look for (e.g. "color distribution", a table/column name, a topic)

tools.name: describe_dashboard
tools.title: Describe a dashboard
tools.description: Return the full structure of one dashboard: its sheets, every visualization (title, chart type, database) and the underlying SQL queries + parameters. Use after search_dashboards to understand how a dashboard is built and what data it uses. Accepts a dashboard id OR a name.

dashboard_id.title: Dashboard id
dashboard_id.description: The dashboard (project) id — or pass `name` instead

name.title: Dashboard name
name.description: Dashboard name (or part of it) if you do not have the id

tools.name: query_dashboard
tools.title: Query a dashboard for insights
tools.description: Run a dashboard's queries against its live database and return sample rows + row counts, so you can answer questions about the actual data. Optionally target one chart by title. Falls back to returning the SQL if live execution is unavailable.

inputSchema.title: Query a dashboard for insights Arguments

visualization.title: Visualization
visualization.description: Optional — only run the query for the chart whose title contains this text

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.title: List dashboards
tools.description: List all Reporting Insights dashboards with a short summary of each (id, name, description, databases, charts).

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.title: Create a dashboard
tools.description: Create AND deploy a new Reporting Insights dashboard from a natural-language description, grounded in a database. Opens the auto-build page which generates + deploys the dashboard.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the dashboard should show (e.g. "sales by region as a pie chart")

database.title: Database
database.description: Database name or engine id to build from (e.g. "alphabet2")

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.title: Edit a dashboard
tools.description: Open an existing Reporting Insights dashboard for editing / redeploying.
